structured.answer: From what I could make out, the page puts the cheapest choice as a securities account at "פסגות" with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". With the amounts it already had filled in (10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, 70,000 ₪ in all) it says I'd be left with about 86,492 ₪. I wouldn't do anything until I've talked it over with you, though. I don't know פסגות the way I know my own bank, and the screens filled up with red minus numbers.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the title and the row of buttons
stuck.why: It starts with 'השקעה במדד', S&P 500, MSCI and נאסד"ק. On my own I'd have closed it there. I only kept going because I had a task.
I didn't touch them. I left 10,000 / 500 / 10 years / 7%. I'm not sure 7% a year is real, or who decided it.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the coloured bar and the dots underneath it
stuck.why: Lots of colours and small words (דמי משמרת, המרת מטבע, עמלות זו על זו). I couldn't tell which colour went with what.

stuck.where: Screens 3 and 4, the list of funds
stuck.why: Red minus numbers all the way down (−447, −1,268, −4,492 ₪) and then long English names. That scared me and I stopped there.

skimmed: Fund list on screen 3 (the coloured tags on each row)
The remarks 'לא בחישוב' under each bank
skipped: The 'אינפלציה' button and the line about the dollar rate
The coloured cost bar at the top of screen 2
The 'מחיר אחר' notes for young people, soldiers and students
Screens 5 to 10, which I never got to
unsure_meaning: S&P 500, MSCI World, MSCI AC World, ETF, UCITS, USD, Accumulating/Distributing
מדד (in the sense of shares, not prices)
קרן מחקה, קרן סל, צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד, נאמן, דמי משמרת
'+0.37% בשנה · שנה אחת' compared with 'לעומת הבחירה' — I couldn't tell plus from minus here
'תשואה בשנה 7%' — whether it's promised or just a guess
not_found: Any word on whether this is as safe as a deposit, or what happens if it goes down
Who is behind the site ('מקור') and why I should trust it
A simple sentence telling me what to do if I'm with Bank Hapoalim, for example
How much I'd have in a deposit, to compare

findings.what: It opens straight away with English letters and shares. For someone who comes for safe saving, it says 'not for you' from the first line.
findings.where: Screen 1, title and the index buttons

findings.what: Dark background with pale grey small text. With my glasses on and the page enlarged it's still hard to read, especially the notes under the numbers.
findings.where: All the screens, especially 'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל' and the notes under each bank

findings.what: Lots of red minus numbers in the fund list. It looks like a loss, and that makes you run.
Two lists side by side (accounts and funds), each with its own numbers. You don't know which to look at first.
The 7% return is filled in from the start and appears as if it were certain. There's no word on risk or losses.
A coloured cost bar with colours close to each other (orange, yellow, red). I couldn't tell them apart.
findings.where: Screen 2 top and the bars in the bank list

findings.what: Lots of coloured tags with jargon on every fund. That's a lot of noise.
The names in the long English lines get lost in the middle.
